bullets.text: A young woman was brutally murdered and beheaded by her alleged lover in Pennalurpet, Tiruvallur district, creating deep shock.
An orange alert for heavy rain was issued for Chennai and Tiruvallur with schools under review for holidays as cyclonic storms formed.
Three people were arrested in Chennai for robbing a couple at knife-point on Besant Nagar beach during the early morning hours.
A two-wheeler parked near Avadi bus station caught fire and burned down due to a Diwali firecracker spark.
Water inflow into Puzhal Lake in Tiruvallur district increased to 1,126 cusecs compared to the previous day.
Temple administration announced that autos are completely banned from going to the Tiruttani Murugan Temple for six days in November.
The government issued an order to create a new corporation to handle public construction projects exceeding 200 crore rupees.
Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw launched the Semicon 2.0 portal and announced twelve new approvals under the electronics manufacturing scheme.
An AI startup founded by IIT Madras alumni offered up to one million dollars to solve five materials science problems.
Rajmohan shared shocking information regarding an alleged AI scam involving the DMK during a television debate.
